name: Tile
summary: The borderless card of Studio: a thumbnail, a title, one meta line and an icon action, laid out in a TileGrid split by a 1px gap that shows the parent surface.
useWhen: A browsable grid of files, boards, templates or assets, where the thumbnail and the name do most of the work
A Studio dashboard of many equal items that should read as one surface cut into cells
A grid where every item opens on click and holds at most one or two icon actions
avoidWhen: An item that needs a description, a body or labelled buttons
A single item on its own, away from a grid
Rows of text that people scan and compare
Picking one option out of several

size.description: Padding and type size: space s with a small title, or space l with a medium title.

selected.description: Draws a 2px ring inside the tile (not color alone) and sets data-selected. Say it in words too, with aria-current on the TileLink.

asChild.description: On Tile and TileGrid: renders the single child element as the root, for example a ul grid of li tiles.

href.description: On TileLink: the target. Its hit area covers the whole tile.

children.description: TileMedia, TileTitle (with a TileLink), TileMeta, TileActions. TileGrid takes Tiles.

a11y.role: None on the tile. The title is a heading; a whole tile link is one native link inside it. A ul TileGrid with li tiles (asChild) gives a list role and a count.
a11y.focus: The tile never takes focus. Tab reaches the TileLink, then the actions. Focus draws a double ring inside the tile (2px ring, 2px gap, 2px ring), so the grid's clip never hides it and it never looks like the single selected ring.

keys.Tab: Moves to the tile link, then to its actions, then to the next tile
keys.Enter: On the tile link: opens it

a11y.announce: The link is named by the full title, even when the visible title is cut at two lines. The meta line is read after it.
notes: The title is cut at two lines with an ellipsis; the link still holds the full name. Keep names short enough to read in two lines.
Actions sit above the stretched link target and keep their own 24px targets.
Forced colors: every tile gets a CanvasText border, the selected one a Highlight outline at its edge, focus a Highlight outline one step further in.

en.title: The item's name, sentence case: Spring launch.
en.meta: One short fact: Edited 2 hours ago.
en.actions: An icon action names its item: More actions for Spring launch.

ar.title: The item's name in white Saudi dialect, no diacritics: إطلاق الربيع.
ar.meta: One short fact, Western digits: آخر تعديل قبل 3 أيام.

react.note: Motion: none of its own. The hover swaps the surface tone at once, as the source does. fade-rise is named for the entrance of a tile into its grid, which the parent drives, from the 1.11 catalog list. TileGrid is a second root (data-ds tile-grid) styled in TileGrid.css, with no manifest of its own.

angular.note: dsTileGrid and dsTile on the host, parts as attribute directives. Tile.css as is.

native.note: A FlatList with numColumns and a hairline gap on the parent surface; each tile a Pressable.

styles.studio: Borderless tiles on surface 2, square inside the grid, split by a 1px gap that shows the parent; the grid rounds the outside with radius.panel. Hover steps to surface 3.
styles.desk: recipes/Tile.css: the grid opens to a space.m gap, each tile is a rounded card on the surface with the hairline border; hover steps to surface 2.
styles.neutral: Planned: reads as a card with 1px borders and white space, through a recipe like Desk's.
styles.liquid: Planned: solid tiles under the glass layer.

mistakes.wrong: Tiles with their own borders and gaps in Studio
mistakes.right: Tiles inside TileGrid; the 1px gap is the separation

mistakes.wrong: A tile with a description paragraph and two labelled buttons
Hiding the tile actions until hover
mistakes.right: Keep them visible, so keyboard and touch reach them
